body: @ZuluForce maybe you can come up with a PR that fixes the issue for you ?

We should consider using [toAddressString](https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/4.1/common/src/main/java/io/netty/util/NetUtil.java#L948) for the address portion which follows the RFC 5952 formatting (last time I checked java didn't). We could also add a method to format a address+port which handles ipv6 and ipv4 correctly ... this is common enough.

Thanks for the replies @normanmaurer  and @Scottmitch. I would need to get the time from my employer to work on this and I currently don't have the Netty development environment setup or approval for the CCLA. If I could submit something it wouldn't be until after the holidays (ie early to mid January).

issue.title: Correctly handle IPV6 in HttpProxyHandler

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

The HttpProxyHandler is expected to be capable of issuing a valid CONNECT request for a tunneled connection to an IPv6 host.

Modifications:

- Correctly format the IPV6 address.
- Add unit tests

Result:

HttpProxyHandler works with IPV6 as well. Fixes [#6152].
